title: Sigiriya
description: Ancient rock fortress near Dambulla, Sri Lanka
extract: Sigiriya or Sinhagiri is an ancient rock fortress located in the northern Matale District near the town of Dambulla in the Central Province, Sri Lanka. It is a site of historical and archaeological significance that is dominated by a massive column of granite approximately 180 m (590 ft) high. According to the ancient Sri Lankan chronicle the Cūlavaṃsa, the area was a large forest.
